subject: POC Kickoff: Redwood POC scope & next steps / AvaTech
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@avatech.com>, AvaTech IT <it-team@avatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-30T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC Kickoff: Redwood POC scope & next steps / AvaTech

Jordan / AvaTech team —

Thanks again for the 60-minute discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared plan before kickoff: 

What we heard (pain points)
- Current search and summarization pipelines are inconsistent in latency and cost; inconsistent answers across customer-facing channels.
- Hard to scale embeddings-based reranking without significant infra overhead.
- Security/compliance is a gating factor (audit logs, data retention, VPC).

Goals for the POC (success metrics)
- Latency: tail p95 response under 400ms for user-facing prompts at target concurrency (50 RPS).
- Cost: reduce per-1000-token inference cost by ~30% vs current setup.
- Quality: Achieve >=85% relevance on the prompt evaluation set (we'll co-develop a prompt/test set).

Proposed POC scope (2-4 weeks)
1) Ingest a representative prompt set (50-100 prompts) you provide for classification/ranking and summarization flows.
2) Run a baseline evaluation on your current infra and a Redwood-hosted POC instance.
3) Configure caching + batching + a lightweight reranking pipeline.
4) Shared dashboard for latency/cost/quality; weekly check-ins.

Owners and timeline
- Rishi Malhotra (Account lead) — overall coordination / commercial questions
- Marissa Cole (Sales Engineer) — technical onboarding, evals, prompt set design
- Jordan Lee (AvaTech) — product owner / access to datasets and infra contacts
- Laura Bennett (CSM) — kickoff scheduling / success milestones

What we need from you before kickoff
- Representative prompt set (50-100) + expected relevance labels (if available) — deliver by 2027-04-03
- GCP project ID or temporary service account for evaluation (read-only access to sample data) — details in the infra checklist attachment
- Confirmation of network preferences (VPC peering vs. SFTP upload) and security reviewer contact

Attachments: POC_SOW_v1.pdf (scope & commercial), network_infra_checklist.xlsx (IT checklist) — see links below.

Next steps
- I'll send an invite for the kickoff meeting (proposed 2027-04-05) after you confirm availability.
- Marissa will follow up with a technical checklist and initial eval plan inline.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Subject: Re: POC Kickoff: Redwood POC scope & next steps / AvaTech

Thanks Rishi — solid recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Primary metric: for the first phase we'd prioritize relevance (we want to avoid hallucinations) and measure precision@5 on the supplied evaluation set; latency is secondary but still important.
- Timeline: 2-3 week POC works best for us. We can commit to delivering the prompt set + labels by EOD 2027-04-02.
- Access: I'll ask IT to create a service account for redwood-poc@avatech (read-only) and to whitelist the Redwood IPs per the checklist. We'll also provide a temporary SFTP endpoint if VPC peering takes longer. Expect the IT contact (it-team@avatech.com) to follow up with the service-account details by tomorrow.

Couple of asks from our security reviewer: can Redwood provide SOC 2 evidence and a short note on how audit logs are exported? If you can attach the SOC 2 link or a pointer that would help speed approval.

Jordan
Product Manager, AvaTech

Subject: Re: POC Kickoff: Redwood POC scope & next steps / AvaTech — technical kickoff items

Jordan / IT —

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few technical details so your team can prep before the kickoff: 

1) Prompt set + evals
- We'll co-develop a 50-100 prompt set. Please include expected label(s) where possible (relevance score 0-3 or gold ranking). Marissa will provide a simple CSV template.

2) Data/access
- Preferred: grant a read-only service account (redwood-poc@avatech) with access to the sample dataset in GCS. If that's not possible right away, SFTP with a temp key works.
- If you prefer VPC peering, we'll need the peering CIDR and a contact for networking. The attached network_infra_checklist.xlsx lists the fields we typically need.

3) Eval plan & metrics
- Baseline run: we'll run your baseline locally (you'll provide a container or endpoint) and a Redwood-hosted run.
- Metrics: precision@5, p95 latency, tokens-per-request cost. We'll generate an eval report and share a dashboard link.

4) Prompt engineering / tests
- We'll start with 25 prompts for the first iteration and iterate weekly. Please flag any prompts with PII — we'll exclude or redact.

5) Kickoff meeting
- Proposed times: 2027-04-05 10:00-11:00 PT or 2027-04-05 15:00-16:00 PT. Please confirm what works for your team.

Attachments: network_infra_checklist.xlsx (same as mentioned)

I'll prepare the eval harness and share the initial template by tomorrow morning. Looking forward to the kickoff — we should be able to have an initial baseline within 48 hours after we get access.

—Marissa
